# Rivera Pools Riverside

> Rivera Pools Riverside is a licensed California C-35 pool remodeling and plastering contractor (CSLB #1053279) serving Riverside County and North San Diego County. Specializing in pool resurfacing, plaster replastering, StoneScapes pebble finishes, Diamond Brite quartz, custom travertine coping, waterline tile, pool leak detection, equipment upgrades, and Baja shelf additions.

## Core Pool Services

- [Pool Resurfacing](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-resurfacing): White plaster, quartz, and StoneScapes pebble resurfacing with 15–20 year longevity.
- [Pool Remodeling](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-remodeling): Comprehensive structural renovations, Baja shelves, plumbing, and aesthetic redesigns.
- [Pool Leak Detection](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-leak-detection): Pressure testing, dye testing, and precision pinpointing for pool shells, returns, skimmers, and underground plumbing.
- [Pool Equipment Upgrades](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-equipment-upgrades): Variable-speed pumps (energy-efficient), cartridge filters, salt chlorination, LED lighting, and smart phone automation.
- [Pebble Finishes](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-finishes/pebble): Premium natural pebble aggregate surfaces, stain-resistant and durable.
- [StoneScapes Finishes](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-finishes/stone-scapes): Certified StoneScapes aggregate finishes with rich water color options.
- [Quartz Finishes](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-finishes/quartz): Ceramic-coated quartz aggregate blend for smooth, stain-resistant finish.
- [Diamond Brite Finishes](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-finishes/diamond-brite): Factory-blended quartz interior pool finishes.
- [Travertine Coping & Tile](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/travertine-coping): Natural French-pattern and bullnose travertine coping paired with porcelain or glass waterline tile.
- [Pool Plaster Delamination Repair](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/pool-plaster-delaminating): Diagnosis and repair of hollow, separating pool plaster surfaces.
- [Rough Pool Plaster Repair](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/rough-pool-plaster-repair): Smoothing, acid-washing, or complete replastering of pitted and abrasive pool finishes.
- [Baja Shelf Addition Cost & Design](https://www.riverapoolsriverside.com/baja-shelf-addition-cost): Adding shallow sun shelves, umbrella sleeves, and bubblers to existing pools.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Grounding Context)

- **How long does pool resurfacing take?** Typical replastering or StoneScapes resurfacing takes 5 to 7 business days from water drainage to initial refilling. Complete remodels (including coping, waterline tile, and equipment) usually take 2 to 3 weeks.
- **What is the lifespan of StoneScapes pebble finishes?** StoneScapes pebble finishes last 15 to 20+ years when pool water chemistry is properly balanced, compared to 7 to 10 years for traditional white plaster.
- **Is Rivera Pools licensed and insured?** Yes, Rivera Pools Riverside is fully licensed by the California Contractors State License Board (CSLB #1053279, Class C-35 Swimming Pool Contractor) and carries comprehensive liability insurance.
- **Does Rivera Pools charge for estimates?** No, all on-site evaluations and estimates are completely free for homeowners in Riverside County and North San Diego County.
